property: an exact fixture exception must not hide a different token in the same file
limits: Proves the same-file additional-token property of native fixture exceptions, not history, all detectors, all policy validation, or gitleaks. The anchor is a synthetic path-only matcher mutation against the current real scanner, not a historical scanner revision.

cases.name: known-fixture
cases.why: One reviewed synthetic sentinel with an exact exception.

cases.name: extra-secret
cases.why: An additional synthetic token in the same file has no matching exception.

anchors.why: Runs the real scanner with only its exact matcher replaced by whole-file acceptance; must miss the bad case and agree on the good case.
